Unrestricted signed mixtures need not be decomposable, and linear tag energy can again be threaded by G13/G15 affine combinations; O(m^4) replication also grows the honest baseline without a proved relative gap.

Proposal 7 imports valuated-matroid exchange curvature outside its valid 0/1 or nonnegative base domain. Unrestricted signed lattice coefficients can traverse cheap alternating exchange circuits or drops, and neither the valuation nor the emitted exchange lattice is frozen; no argument converts a missing common base into B n^(2c) excess.

G14 excludes vectors only through B+32 on one 520-selector pair-bag instance; it proves no composition or growing-gap law. Proposal 1's single-sketch test and Proposal 4's four-variable test do not address that missing asymptotic requirement.
